messages.name: float
messages.description: In left inlet: Sets the frequency of the oscillator.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: Sets the frequency of the oscillator.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: In left inlet: Sets the frequency of the oscillator.In right inlet: (optional) A sync signal. When the control signal crosses from below 0.5 to above 0.5, the oscillator resets itself. Aobject works well for this purpose. The classic use is to set this control signal to your fundamental frequency and "sweep" the left frequency input in a range somewhere several octaves higher than the fundamental.

messages.name: synctrig
messages.digest: Set the threshold value for oscillator reset
messages.description: Sets the value which an input signal crosses at which the oscillator will reset itself.
